Stage4 has a CPU layout fallback; original FP32 gates still fail. Full-model quality and performance remain unaccepted.

The core-mask screen measures the same conditional two-block model on two heldouts, with three subsequent calls per case/route. Its 3.28–3.59% descriptive reductions establish no sustained throughput, full-model latency or P95 acceptance.
The six-case CPU capture includes 334 thermal pauses and 334 resumes. Its elapsed wall time is not NPU speed or an uninterrupted forward benchmark.
